//: Capability manifest for <List> (the .pa-list container) — svelte-pure-admin. See card.map.json for the model. CONTAINER-ONLY slice: List.svelte is a fixed <div class="pa-list {class}"> wrapper with a `children` slot — no props beyond content + class passthrough. It has NO `as` prop (div-only, single-shape wrapper); keen's div|ul `as` is an absorbed API divergence covered in keen's own test, not a shared feature. Per-item structure (ListItem.svelte) is the DEFERRED sub-slice — not mapped here.
